title: How is Hitler connected to Hatsune Miku?
description: Six real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Hatsune Miku, through a former king, Churchill, the Queen, a president and a late-night host.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Hatsune Miku?

image.file: File:Duc et duchesse de Windsor avec Hitler (1937).jpg

links.line: In 1937, Hitler welcomed Britain's former king, Edward VIII.

image.file: File:Churchill with Duke of Windsor in 1948.jpg

links.line: In 1948, Edward holidayed on the French Riviera with Winston Churchill.
On Victory in Europe Day, 1945, Churchill stood beside young Princess Elizabeth.

image.file: File:Barack Obama Michelle Obama Queen Elizabeth II Buckingham Palace London.jpg

links.line: In 2009, the Queen welcomed Barack Obama to Buckingham Palace.

image.file: File:2012 President Barack Obama with David Letterman.jpg

links.line: In 2012, Obama sat down with David Letterman on the Late Show.

image.credit: CBS / Late Show with David Letterman (via Grantland)

links.line: And in 2014, Letterman shared his stage with the hologram pop star Hatsune Miku.
